name: fix-ci
title: Fix CI: {{params.check_name}}
description: When a pull request's check fails: send the worktree's agent the failing tail of the CI log, wait, run a local check, repeat up to max rounds, then push.
tokens: One prompt of about 110 characters plus the failing CI lines and tail, at most 3 KB; later rounds send only the local check's failing tail, at most 3 KB.

agent.description: started in the worktree when no agent runs there

check.description: a local check to pass before pushing

steps.command: u={{params.check_url}}; id=$(printf %s "$u" | sed -n 's#.*/actions/runs/\([0-9][0-9]*\).*#\1#p'); if [ -n "$id" ]; then gh run view "$id" --log-failed 2>&1 | tail -c 40000; else echo "No GitHub Actions run in $u"; fi
